about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer based in Grenoble, France, with a double master's in computer science and computational linguistics. From React/TypeScript interfaces to Python/FastAPI backends, I enjoy building products end to end — and my research background in linguistics and NLP gives me an extra edge with text and language data.

I currently work as a freelance web developer while diving into AI agent development — learning how to make large language models call tools and orchestrate workflows to build genuinely useful, intelligent applications. I'm excited for new challenges and for growing together with a team.

items.name: HeurAIDEAS
items.description: A collaborative research platform for the heuristic evaluation of human-machine interfaces (HMI): project management, WebSocket-synchronized scoring and team-level data isolation — architected, built and deployed end to end.

items.name: Nestery
items.description: A personal productivity suite: kanban tasks, notes in plain text, rich text or Markdown, and a calendar with public holidays and ICS subscriptions — all in one workspace with email/GitHub sign-in and light/dark themes.

items.name: Travel Tracker
items.description: A travel journaling app: log flights and train journeys, visualize routes on an interactive map, and review trips through a stats dashboard with charts — featuring CSV import and dark mode.

items.name: ViteMétéo
items.description: A lightweight weather app with a redesigned light/dark interface: geocoded city search with multi-city management, current conditions, a 24-hour hourly forecast and a 10-day outlook, Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle, browser geolocation and a French/English/Chinese UI — powered by the keyless Open-Meteo API.

items.name: NLP Jobs
items.description: A job board dedicated to NLP positions: paginated listings, multi-criteria filters (country, city, keywords, urgent) and detailed job pages, with the frontend on Netlify and the APIs on Netlify Functions.

items.name: CartoStages IDéaL
items.description: An internship-offers platform built for the Master IdL (Language Engineering) at Université Grenoble Alpes: it aggregates offers from multiple sources, displays them on an interactive map, and provides search, publishing and admin features — including a Python scraping module.
Working as an independent web developer, owning every project end to end — from requirements and architecture to deployment and delivery.
Designed and built HeurAIDEAS from scratch — a collaborative web app for the heuristic evaluation of human-machine interfaces (HMI) — owning the full delivery from architecture to deployment.
highlights: Designed and developed HeurAIDEAS end to end, a collaborative web app dedicated to the heuristic evaluation of human-machine interfaces (HMI), with an async Python/FastAPI backend and a React/TypeScript/Vite frontend.
Developed REST APIs with SQLAlchemy Async/Alembic and implemented WebSockets for real-time synchronization and presence management.
Implemented JWT/OAuth2 authentication and RBAC access control to guarantee data isolation between users and teams.
Integrated S3 file storage and containerized the app with Docker, migrating hosting from the cloud to on-premises servers; set up continuous deployment (CD) from Git to Render and Netlify.
Ran the development in Agile/Kanban style: task breakdown, prioritization, progress tracking and project management.
Contributed to the gradual migration of a SaaS application from Vue.js to React with TypeScript.
Built modular frontend components: dashboard, authentication and user data management.
Integrated APIs to dynamically display user data, including profiles and recent activity.
Worked in an Agile environment — sprints, daily standups, Git — collaborating closely with the product team.
Fine-tuned BERT and DistilBERT models on a French geolinguistic corpus.
Preprocessed, annotated and structured text data for NER model training.
Trained and evaluated named entity recognition (NER) models with Transformers.
Compared the performance of BERT, DistilBERT and spaCy on NER tasks.
